# Glympse Core SDK for Android: API outline (llms-full.txt)

Companion to AGENTS.md. This is an outline of the public API surface for the core platform. Kotlin sees `getX()`/`isX()`
as properties; method names are otherwise identical in Java. `GArray<T>` is iterable. String constants are static
methods (`GC.CONSENT_TYPE_SUBJECT()`); int constants are fields (`GC.INVITE_TYPE_LINK`). Verify exact signatures in
the AAR before relying on an item here. Not covered: groups, cards, POIs, triggers, place search, chat, customer
pickups, linked accounts, directions/route planning, map and UI controls.

## 0. Packages
- com.glympse.android.api: GlympseFactory, GGlympse, GC (constants), GE (events), GConfig, GConsentManager,
  GUserManager, GUser, GUserTicket, GHistoryManager, GTicket, GInvite, GPlace, GLocationManager, GNetworkManager,
  GBatteryManager, GEventListener, GEventSink, GImage, GTrack
- com.glympse.android.core: GArray, GPrimitive, CoreFactory, CoreConstants (location state/permission constants),
  GDrawable, GLocation, GLatLng
- com.glympse.android.push: GlympseFCM (static helpers, optional artifact)

## 1. Maven coordinates (group com.glympse, same version for all)
- glympseapi (core), glympseapi-push (optional). Other optional artifacts exist (map, controls, contacts): not covered
- Repo: https://raw.github.com/Glympse/glympse-android-sdk-release/master
- Latest version: the <release> element of <repo>/com/glympse/glympseapi/maven-metadata.xml

## 2. GlympseFactory (static)
- createGlympse(Context, server, apiKey): GGlympse. Returns the RUNNING instance if one exists (ignores arguments).
  An overload with a `prefix` exists but prefixes are not supported on Android
- createTicket(durationMs, message, destination): GTicket (message/destination optional)
- createInvite(type, name, address): GInvite; createInvite(type, subtype, name, address); createPublicInvite(name)
- createRequest(requestTicket, invite): GTicket
- createPlace(lat, lng, name): GPlace; createAddress(...); createImage(GDrawable)
- createTrackBuilder(); account profile helpers (createPhoneAccountProfile, createEmailAccountProfile, ...)
- Never implement model interfaces yourself; always obtain them from here or from the platform

## 3. GGlympse (extends GEventSink: addListener / removeListener)
Lifecycle and account:
- start(): once per instance. Silently returns if server or API key is empty. Fires PLATFORM_STARTED synchronously
- stop(): may be called from any thread (posted to the main thread); never from inside eventsOccurred. Instance dead after
- isStarted(), isFirstLaunch() (valid right after creation; resets after logout()), hasUserAccount()
- logout(): false while started. Wipes account, nickname, avatar, history, consent; next start creates a new account
- login(GPrimitive profile): before first start only; recovers an existing account (profile from GlympseFactory helpers);
  ignored if an account exists. confirmAccount(type, profile): sends a confirmation code, returns a sink
- setActive(bool): reference counted; returns the count. start() resets it to 0. isActive()
- getAccessToken(): short-lived; query each time; null until PLATFORM_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED
- getTime(): server time in ms. getApiVersion(): "major.minor.build"
Configuration BEFORE start() (none persisted): setHandler(GHandler) (custom concurrency; default is the creating
thread's Looper), setSmsSendMode(SMS_SEND_MODE_*), enableSmsScraping(bool) (needs RECEIVE_SMS),
setEtaMode(ETA_MODE_EXTERNAL default | INTERNAL), setRestoreHistory(bool, default false), setHistoryLookback(ms),
allowSiblingTickets(bool, default false), enableInviteViewersTracking(bool), setBrand(String) (subcategory of the API
key for invite branding)
Managers (most are null before start): getConfig() and getConsentManager() work before start. After start:
getUserManager(), getHistoryManager(), getLocationManager(), getNetworkManager(), getBatteryManager(),
getDirectionsManager(), getGroupManager(), getCardManager(), getPoiManager(), ...
Invites: decodeInvite(code, mode[, GInvite]): GEventSink; openUrl(message, mode, GInvite?): bool; extractInviteCodes(message)
and getInviteAspect(code) are thread-safe; cleanupInviteCode, compareInviteCodes; viewTicket(GUserTicket): GTicket?
Tickets: sendTicket(GTicket): bool; requestTicket(GTicket)
Push: registerDeviceToken(token) / registerDeviceToken(type, token) (ignored until started), unregisterDeviceToken,
hasValidDeviceToken, handleRemoteNotification(payload) (ignored until started)
Debug: verify() (checks only the INTERNET permission), overrideLoggingLevels(file, debug), setLogReceiver(GLogReceiver),
showDebugView()

## 4. GConsentManager (available before start)
- hasConsent(), getConsentState() (USER_CONSENT_NONE / NO / YES / EXEMPT strings)
- exemptFromConsent(bool): before start(); not persisted
- grantConsent(CONSENT_TYPE_SUBJECT() | CONSENT_TYPE_GUARDIAN(), partnerId >= 0): starts account creation if none
- revokeConsent(partnerId)
- Events (LISTENER_CONSENT): CONSENT_REQUIRED, CONSENT_SUCCEEDED, CONSENT_FAILED, CONSENT_REVOKE_SUCCEEDED,
  CONSENT_REVOKE_FAILED, CONSENT_MANAGER_SYNCED, CONSENT_MANAGER_SYNC_FAILED
- Constants: GC.PRIVACY_POLICY_URL(), GC.TERMS_AND_CONDITIONS_URL(); agreement text resource R.string.glympse_gdpr_message

## 5. Events (GEventListener.eventsOccurred(glympse, listener, events, obj))
`listener` is one of the LISTENER_* values; `events` is a bitmask. Constants live in GE (alias of GlympseEvents).
LISTENER_PLATFORM (=1), on the platform
- PLATFORM_STARTED, PLATFORM_FIRST_LAUNCH (only the very first start, and again after logout), PLATFORM_STOPPED
- PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_CREATED (new anonymous account), PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_CREATE_FAILED (fatal: platform stops)
- PLATFORM_LOGIN_SUCCEEDED (every start), PLATFORM_LOGIN_FAILED (fatal), PLATFORM_SESSION_FAILED (token expired; SDK
  re-authenticates by itself)
- PLATFORM_SYNCED_WITH_SERVER (once per instance), PLATFORM_TICKET_SYNC_COMPLETED (after every ticket sync)
- PLATFORM_USER_ADDED / _REMOVED / _CHANGED / _LIST_REORDERED (obj: GUser); PLATFORM_LOCATION
- PLATFORM_TICKET_ADDED / _REMOVED / _CHANGED / _LIST_REORDERED / PLATFORM_TICKET_ARRIVED (obj: GTicket)
- PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET, PLATFORM_INVITE_REQUEST (obj: GUserTicket)
- PLATFORM_RATE_LIMITED (server said "rate_limited"; the request is not retried), PLATFORM_STATE_CHANGED (foreground/background change)
LISTENER_INVITE (=2), on the sink returned by decodeInvite
- INVITE_DECODED, INVITE_INVALID_CODE (obj: the invite code String)
LISTENER_USER (=3), on a GUser
- USER_NICKNAME_CHANGED, USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_CHANGED, USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_RESIGNING (still active ticket is readable),
  USER_TICKET_ADDED, USER_TICKET_REMOVED (obj: GTicket), USER_AVATAR_UPLOADED, USER_AVATAR_NOT_UPLOADED
LISTENER_TICKET (=4), on a GTicket (not fired for expired or sibling tickets, except TICKET_TRANSFERRED)
- TICKET_CREATED (invite codes not assigned yet), TICKET_FAILED, TICKET_EXPIRED, TICKET_COMPLETED
- TICKET_INVITE_CREATED (client-delivered invites), TICKET_INVITE_SENT (server-delivered), TICKET_INVITE_UPDATED (viewers,
  fired periodically while watched), TICKET_INVITE_REMOVED, TICKET_INVITE_FAILED
- TICKET_REQUEST_CREATED / _SENT / _FAILED
- TICKET_FIRST_VIEWED, TICKET_INVALID_CODE, TICKET_ARRIVED
- TICKET_DURATION_CHANGED, _MESSAGE_CHANGED, _DESTINATION_CHANGED, _TRACK_CHANGED, _ETA_CHANGED, _ROUTE_CHANGED,
  _TRAVEL_MODE_CHANGED, _VISIBILITY_CHANGED
- TICKET_DATA_APPENDED / _DATA_CLEARED (custom properties, obj: GDataEvent), TICKET_TRANSFERRED / _NOT_TRANSFERRED
LISTENER_NETWORK (=5): NETWORK_START_FAILING, NETWORK_RECOVERED, NETWORK_PUSH_AVAILABILITY_CHANGED, ...
LISTENER_BATTERY (=6): BATTERY_STATE_CHANGED. LISTENER_IMAGE (=7): IMAGE_CHANGED.
LISTENER_LOCATION (=8): LOCATION_STATE_CHANGED, LOCATION_ACCURACY_AUTH_CHANGED. LISTENER_CONSENT (=28): see section 4.

## 6. Users and history
- GUserManager: getSelf(), getUsers() (index 0 is self), getStandaloneUsers(), findUserByUserId, findUserByInviteCode,
  findTicketByInviteCode, startTracking(user)/stopTracking(user) (reference counted; start returns the count, -1 if the
  user is unknown or self), startTrackingAll(), stopTrackingAll(forced), getTracking(), anyActiveTracked(),
  setUserTrackingMode(USER_TRACKING_MODE_ACTIVE default | ALL), enablePersistence(bool, default on)
- GUser: id, isSelf, nickname (setNickname), avatar (GImage, setAvatar(GDrawable)), location, active (GTicket),
  activeStandalone, tickets, findTicketByInviteCode, stopWatching(). Avatars never download automatically: image.load()
- GUserTicket (from PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET/REQUEST): user, ticket, invite
- GHistoryManager (your outgoing tickets): isSynced(), tickets, anyActive(), refresh(), findTicketByTicketId,
  findTicketByInviteCode, enableCancellationTimer(bool, default off) + setCancellationTimeout(ms) (stop retrying ticket creation during a long
  network outage; by default creation is retried until it succeeds)

## 7. Tickets and invites
- GTicket: id, code, state (TICKET_STATE_*), isMine, isSibling, isActive (own active tickets only), isCompleted, user,
  invites, duration, startTime, expireTime, message, destination (GPlace), track, eta, route, travelMode,
  isWatching, isSomeoneWatching
  Mutators (sent tickets): modify(duration, message, destination), clear(message, destination), extend(ms),
  expire() (same as modify with 0), addInvite, deleteInvite, canAddInvite, own() (take over a sibling ticket)
  Custom data: appendData(partnerId, name, GPrimitive) (after TICKET_CREATED), getProperty / getPropertyData /
  getPartnerData(partnerId)
  Request tickets: setRequestEndTime(ms), getRequestTicket(), setRequestNoReply(bool)
- GInvite: type, name, address, code, url (set once the invite exists), state (INVITE_STATE_*), createdTime, lastViewTime,
  viewers, viewing, text (server-formatted message), error, setVisible(bool), setCreateOnly(bool), setRequestTicket,
  initiateClientSideSend(), completeClientSideSend(bool)
- Invite name/address by type: SMS (name optional; phone number required), EMAIL (optional; email required), FACEBOOK /
  TWITTER (optional / optional), ACCOUNT (optional; Glympse user id required), GROUP (optional; group id or name
  required), SHARE (app name; app signature required), APP (app name; addressee id optional), CLIPBOARD (blank),
  LINK (app specific, optional)
- Delivery: server sends EMAIL, social; SMS/LINK/CLIPBOARD/SHARE are client
  delivered: wait for INVITE_STATE_NEEDTOSEND, call initiateClientSideSend (optional), deliver `invite.url`, then
  completeClientSideSend(success)
- Ticket lifetime: sendTicket makes the ticket ADDING and registers it in historyManager. Minimum duration 10 s;
  default maximum 4 h (config.maximumTicketDuration). A ticket can be sent only once

## 8. Config (persisted) and location
- GConfig: setExpireOnArrival(EXPIRE_ON_ARRIVAL_NONE | NOTIFY (default) | AUTO), allowSpeedSharing(bool),
  allowLocationSharing(bool), setDeleteAfterComplete, setActiveSharingNotificationMessage(String),
  getMaximumTicketDuration(), getMaximumNicknameLength(), setDiagnosticDataEnabled(bool), setMetricDirections(bool),
  getDeviceId(), save()
- GLocationManager: getLocation(), startLocation()/stopLocation(forced), getLocationState() (CoreConstants LOCATION_STATE_
  NOT_DETERMINED=1, DENIED=2, ACQUIRED=3, ERROR=4), getLocationPermission() (LOCATION_PERMISSION_ UNKNOWN=0, DISABLED=1,
  WHILE_IN_USE=2, ALWAYS=3), getLocationAccuracyAuthorization() (LOCATION_ACCURACY_AUTH_FULL=0, REDUCED=1; full before
  Android 12)
- ETA: default ETA_MODE_EXTERNAL (you call ticket.updateEta/updateRoute); ETA_MODE_INTERNAL needs a destination.
  Expire on arrival fires PLATFORM_TICKET_ARRIVED and TICKET_ARRIVED

## 9. Constants (GC, alias of GlympseConstants)
- INVITE_TYPE_*: UNKNOWN=0, ACCOUNT=1, EMAIL=2, SMS=3, TWITTER=4, FACEBOOK=5, LINK=6, GROUP=7, SHARE=8, CLIPBOARD=9,
  EVERNOTE=10, APP=11
- INVITE_STATE_*: NONE=0, SERVERSENDING=1, CLIENTSENDING=2, NEEDTOSEND=3, SUCCEEDED=4, DELETING=5, DELETED=6,
  FAILED_TO_CREATE=7, FAILED_TO_SEND=8, FAILED_TO_DELETE=9
- INVITE_MODE_*: DEFAULT=0 (view automatically), PROMPT_BEFORE_VIEWING=1, ACTIVATE_USER=2 (combine with DEFAULT:
  starts tracking). INVITE_ASPECT_*: UNKNOWN, TICKET, REQUEST, CARD
- TICKET_STATE_*: NONE, ADDING, INVALID, ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, DELETING, DELETED, FAILED_TO_CREATE, CANCELLED

## 10. Flows with exact order
A. First run: createGlympse -> addListener -> exemptFromConsent(true) (or consent UI + grantConsent) -> start ->
   STARTED, FIRST_LAUNCH -> ACCOUNT_CREATED -> LOGIN_SUCCEEDED -> SYNCED. Relaunch: STARTED -> LOGIN_SUCCEEDED -> SYNCED.
B. Send: SYNCED -> createTicket -> createInvite -> addInvite -> addListener -> sendTicket -> TICKET_CREATED ->
   TICKET_INVITE_CREATED / _SENT -> (viewers: INVITE_UPDATED) -> modify/extend/expire -> TICKET_EXPIRED -> TICKET_COMPLETED.
C. View: decodeInvite(code, DEFAULT | ACTIVATE_USER) -> PLATFORM_USER_ADDED -> USER_ACTIVE_TICKET_CHANGED -> ticket
   events. With DEFAULT only, call userManager.startTracking(user). With PROMPT_BEFORE_VIEWING: PLATFORM_INVITE_TICKET ->
   viewTicket(userTicket) -> startTracking(user).
D. Foreground/background: onResume setActive(true); onPause setActive(false); one pair per transition.
E. Reset: stop -> logout() -> new instance -> flow A (FIRST_LAUNCH again).

## 11. Android manifest and permission matrix
- Merged by the AAR: INTERNET, WAKE_LOCK, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, FOREGROUND_SERVICE,
  FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION; service com.glympse.android.hal.GlympseService (foregroundServiceType=location, not
  exported); internal broadcast receivers for location and geofence updates
- You add as needed: POST_NOTIFICATIONS (API 33+), ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, SEND_SMS, READ_CONTACTS (before first start),
  RECEIVE_SMS (only with enableSmsScraping)
- Runtime request: COARSE+FINE together, before sending. The SDK polls for the grant every 15 s
- Broadcasts to your package: com.glympse.android.hal.service.STARTED (service restarted; recreate the platform),
  NotificationListener.INTENT_INVITE / INTENT_DATA (push arrived while the platform was not running)
- Push (optional): glympse_fcm_application_id meta-data, provided by Glympse for your package name
